meta.title: SenseNova Model Access
meta.description: Bring SenseNova's language models and draw tool into DSH: the model list follows your key, vision models take images automatically, usable the moment it is registered (off by default); the Token Plan quota panel — credit pools, per-model consumption, self-renewing console token — works without registering, and Xiaohuanxiong signs in by QR code; rate-limit hits back off on their own instead of reading as an exhausted quota.
